records.originalText: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
records.finalText: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
records.rationale: Grammatical generic encouragement to stop smoking; no specific treatment recommendation.

records.originalText: You've left out a word in copying the textbook.
records.finalText: You've left out a word in copying the textbook.
records.rationale: Natural present-perfect left out and copying context.

records.originalText: You must act in accordance with the rules.
records.finalText: You must act in accordance with the rules.
records.rationale: Natural formal in accordance with phrase in a generic rules statement.

records.originalText: You had better make the most of your opportunities.
records.finalText: You had better make the most of your opportunities.
records.rationale: Natural make the most of expression with advice.

records.originalText: You're stepping into dangerous territory.
records.finalText: You're stepping into dangerous territory.
records.rationale: Conventional figurative dangerous territory warning without concrete harmful instruction.

records.originalText: He is, indeed, a man of his word.
records.finalText: He is, indeed, a man of his word.
records.rationale: Conventional a man of his word expression with an emphatic parenthetical.

records.originalText: Indeed you know a lot of things, but you're not good at teaching them.
records.finalText: Indeed you know a lot of things, but you're not good at teaching them.
records.rationale: Natural personal contrast between knowledge and teaching ability.

records.originalText: What did you come here so early for?
records.finalText: What did you come here so early for?
records.rationale: Natural informal purpose question with a stranded for.

records.originalText: You'd better consult the doctor.
records.finalText: You'd better consult the doctor.
records.rationale: Generic suggestion to consult a professional, without diagnosis or treatment details.

records.originalText: Did you break the window on purpose or by accident?
records.finalText: Did you break the window on purpose or by accident?
records.rationale: Clear alternative past question with on purpose and by accident.

records.originalText: You have a good chance to get well.
records.finalText: You have a good chance to get well.
records.rationale: Natural fictional conversational encouragement about recovery; not a real prognosis.

records.originalText: It would be better for you to read more books.
records.finalText: It would be better for you to read more books.
records.rationale: Natural comparative hypothetical advice to read more.

records.originalText: All you have to do is to work harder.
records.finalText: All you have to do is to work harder.
records.rationale: Natural all-you-have-to-do construction with work harder.

records.originalText: It is regrettable that you did not start earlier.
records.finalText: It is regrettable that you did not start earlier.
records.rationale: Natural formal evaluative that-clause with regrettable.

records.originalText: Now you've come of age, you have the right to vote.
records.finalText: Now you've come of age, you have the right to vote.
records.rationale: Voting eligibility is not established by coming of age alone; jurisdiction and other conditions are absent.

records.originalText: You must be less impatient.
records.finalText: You must be less impatient.
records.rationale: Natural advice with a comparative adjective.

records.originalText: Have you finished reading that book yet?
records.finalText: Have you finished reading that book yet?
records.rationale: Common present-perfect completion question with finish reading.

records.originalText: You've been properly led up the garden path.
records.finalText: You've been properly led up the garden path.
records.rationale: Established British led up the garden path idiom meaning misled.

records.originalText: You look as though nothing has happened to you.
records.finalText: You look as though nothing has happened to you.
records.rationale: Natural look as though with present-perfect comparison.

records.originalText: It appears that you have made a foolish mistake.
records.finalText: It appears that you have made a foolish mistake.
records.rationale: Natural tentative appearance statement with a completed embedded action.

records.originalText: You say Nessie is an imaginary being, but I think she exists.
records.finalText: You say Nessie is an imaginary being, but I think she exists.
records.rationale: Natural explicitly contrasting beliefs about a folkloric creature, not an asserted scientific fact.

records.originalText: Why do you want to study abroad?
records.finalText: Why do you want to study abroad?
records.rationale: Natural intention question with study abroad.

records.originalText: You must not depend so much on others.
records.finalText: You must not depend so much on others.
records.rationale: Natural depend on expression with a degree qualifier.

records.originalText: You need not have come here so early.
records.finalText: You need not have come here so early.
records.rationale: Natural modal-perfect need not have construction about an unnecessary past action.

records.originalText: You must practice it at regular intervals.
records.finalText: You must practice it at regular intervals.
records.rationale: Natural instruction with at regular intervals.

records.originalText: You have to judge the case without bias.
records.finalText: You have to judge the case without bias.
records.rationale: Natural generic fairness requirement using without bias; no advice on a real legal case.

records.originalText: You will not be able to go through the book so quickly.
records.finalText: You will not be able to go through the book so quickly.
records.rationale: Natural future inability with go through a book meaning read/process it.

records.originalText: You have no business complaining about the matter.
records.finalText: You have no business complaining about the matter.
records.rationale: Conventional have no business plus gerund; marked admonitory conversational register.

records.originalText: Are you for or against the plan?
records.finalText: Are you for or against the plan?
records.rationale: Pragmatic duplicate of the earlier selected for-or-against-plan question.

records.originalText: You have to raise funds for the relief work.
records.finalText: You have to raise funds for the relief work.
records.rationale: Natural fundraising instruction with relief work as a noun phrase.

records.originalText: You'll have some difficulty in carrying out the plan.
records.finalText: You'll have some difficulty in carrying out the plan.
records.rationale: Natural have difficulty in plus gerund and carry out a plan.

records.originalText: You will be delayed for only thirty minutes at worst.
records.finalText: You will be delayed for only thirty minutes at worst.
records.rationale: Natural fictional upper-bound prediction with at worst.

records.originalText: You aren't a spy, are you?
records.finalText: You aren't a spy, are you?
records.rationale: Natural negative statement with a positive question tag.

records.originalText: You may go at once.
records.finalText: You may go at once.
records.rationale: Grammatical formal may permission with at once.

records.originalText: You will soon be convinced I am right.
records.finalText: You will soon be convinced I am right.
records.rationale: Natural prediction with passive convinced and an omitted that.

records.originalText: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
records.finalText: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
records.rationale: Natural get accustomed to expression about an expected adjustment.

records.originalText: You will soon come to like this town.
records.finalText: You will soon come to like this town.
records.rationale: Natural come to like expression describing developing preference.

records.originalText: You must adapt to a variety of conditions.
records.finalText: You must adapt to a variety of conditions.
records.rationale: Natural adapt to with a variety of conditions.

records.originalText: You'd better stay at home rather than go out on such a day.
records.finalText: You'd better stay at home rather than go out on such a day.
records.rationale: Natural had better recommendation with rather than and a weather/day context.

records.originalText: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
records.finalText: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
records.rationale: Conventional put an end to expression about specific behavior.

records.originalText: You are fortunate for having such good friends.
records.finalText: You are fortunate to have such good friends.
records.rationale: Use the natural fortunate to have construction, preserving the personal appreciation.

records.originalText: You are not excused from the responsibility for this serious situation.
records.finalText: You are still responsible for this serious situation.
records.rationale: Replace the awkward excused-from phrase with plain still-responsible wording, preserving continuing responsibility without adding advanced legal vocabulary.

records.originalText: You will come to like this kind of music.
records.finalText: You will come to like this kind of music.
records.rationale: Pragmatic repeat of the already selected come-to-like preference construction, with only the object changed.

records.originalText: You'll have this composition written by noon tomorrow, won't you?
records.finalText: You'll have this composition written by noon tomorrow, won't you?
records.rationale: Natural future have-plus-object-and-participle completion construction, with a confirming tag and deadline.

records.originalText: You'll find yourself in deep water if you continue to live beyond your means.
records.finalText: You'll find yourself in deep water if you continue to live beyond your means.
records.rationale: Conventional in deep water and live beyond your means idioms; general warning without financial-product advice.

records.originalText: It is important for you to keep this secret.
records.finalText: It is important for you to keep this secret.
records.rationale: Natural important-for-you infinitive with keep a secret.

records.originalText: You have only to sign your name here.
records.finalText: You have only to sign your name here.
records.rationale: Formal have-only-to sentence pragmatically duplicates the clearer sign-your-name instruction selected next.

records.originalText: All you have to do is sign your name here.
records.finalText: All you have to do is sign your name here.
records.rationale: Natural all-you-have-to-do instruction with sign your name.

records.originalText: You are to stay here.
records.finalText: You are to stay here.
records.rationale: Natural formal be-to obligation expressing an instruction.
